title: Regularisation of supersymmetric theories
journal: contribution to 'Perspectives on Supersymmetry' (ed. G.L. Kane, World Scientific); no journal ref on arXiv
claim: Review. DRED is the regulator of choice for SUSY theories; the Siegel-type ambiguities (epsilon tensors, gamma5) are regarded as technical and avoidable for physical results; the one-loop SUSY Ward identity holds in DRED; the Avdeev-Chochia-Vladimirov ambiguity in the propagator Ward identity of pure SYM needs at least four loops; superfield methods do not escape it; DRED beta functions deviate from the NSVZ form from three loops but are related to it by a coupling redefinition; in softly broken SUSY the epsilon-scalar mass enters two-loop scalar-mass beta functions and is removed by the DRED' redefinition; the van Damme-'t Hooft unitarity problem is resolved by separate treatment of epsilon-scalar couplings.
loop_order: review: 1-loop Ward identity; >= 4-loop onset of the ACV ambiguity; 3-loop DRED/NSVZ deviation; 4-loop DRED beta up to one unknown parameter (status 1997)
theory: N=1 SYM and general N=1 gauge theories; N=2, N=4; softly broken SUSY
scheme: DRED (component and superfield), DRED' for soft breaking, comparison with DREG.
symmetry_argument: (i) Insertion of the Fierz-vanishing variation delta L_S and gamma-trace counting (ACV); (ii) NSVZ vs DRED related by coupling redefinitions; (iii) N=2 one-loop finiteness used to fix the three-loop DRED gauge beta function.

assumed: Sec. 4: the Delta ambiguity is expected not to affect physical results (stated expectation, no proof).
checked_partially: Sec. 7, eq. (48): three-loop DRED beta_g fixed using N=2 one-loop finiteness; eq. (49): four-loop result up to one parameter alpha; N=1 SQCD limit cancellation of QCD group invariants called an excellent check.

evidence: Sec. 3, eqs. (15)-(19): Siegel ambiguity, e.g. (d+1)(d-2) epsilonhat^{mu nu} = 0; eq. (25): gamma5 via epsilon tensors, factor epsilon tensors out; eq. (26) Hull-Townsend prescription gives same physics in one case (Allen-Jones NPB 303 (1988) 271).
Sec. 4, eqs. (27)-(38): SYM in WZ gauge, delta L_S (29), Delta (36)-(38), Tr Delta = 48 d(d-1)(d-2)(d-3)(d-4); 'at least four loops'.
Sec. 6, eqs. (40)-(43): epsilon-scalar mass m~^2, inhomogeneous beta, DRED' (41), top-mass one-loop coefficient 5 (DRED) vs 4 (DREG).
Sec. 7, eqs. (46)-(49): NSVZ, deviation at 3 loops (refs Jack-Jones-North NPB 473 (1996) 308, PLB 386 (1996) 138).
red_flags: Sec. 1: whether a fully satisfactory SUSY regulator exists for gauge theories is called controversial.
No loop order is given up to which SUSY is guaranteed; ambiguity estimate rests on ACV's counting argument.
cross_checks: Jack-Jones-North and Jack-Jones-Pickering beta-function papers (section 1e, other worker)
